Name: Simple Weapon Balance
Author: Bennoloth
Description:
I was a big hammer lover in the Mines as a fresh Stardew Player. Spending 75,000g to get that Galaxy Hammer was going to be so worth it! Except... it wasn't.

I respecced into crit lategame to finally try out Daggers... except they were unreliable and nowhere near worth the short range.

Surely the special endgame weapons from the rare Volcano chests will have something cool? 50 Crit Power? That's... it...?

This mod buffs the Galaxy Hammer, Galaxy Dagger, Dragontooth weapons, and Dwarf weapons to compete balance-wise with the Galaxy Sword and Infinity Blade. The stats for the modded weapons are below.

[b]Galaxy Sword (unchanged): [/b]60-80 damage, +4 Speed
[b]Infinity Blade:[/b] 80-100 damage, +8 Speed
[b]Dragontooth Cutlass:[/b] 60-80 damage, -4 Speed, +10 Crit Chance, +75 Crit Power, +5 Weight
[b]Dwarf Sword:[/b] 75-75 damage, +2 Speed, +6 Defense, +5 Weight

[b]Galaxy Hammer:[/b] 75-100 damage, +2 Speed
[b]Infinity Gavel:[/b] 150-150 damage, -5 Speed, +250 Crit Power
[b]Dragontooth Club:[/b] 75-100 damage, -2 Speed, +5 Crit Chance, +50 Crit Power, +5 Weight
[b]Dwarf Hammer:[/b] 75-100 damage, +3 Speed, +6 Defense, +5 Weight

[b]Galaxy Dagger:[/b] 40-100 damage, +6 Crit Chance
[b]Infinity Dagger:[/b] 60-120 damage, +8 Crit Chance
[b]Dragontooth Shiv:[/b] 50-50 damage, +20 Crit Chance, +100 Crit Power
[b]Dwarf Dagger:[/b] 50-75 damage, +6 Defense, +5 Weight, +6 Crit Chance

The idea is for the Galaxy/Infinity weapons to be a general DPS boost with no special attributes, the Dragontooth weapons to have enough crit chance to be viable crit weapons, and the Dwarf weapons to be lower damage but reliable and viable defensive weapons.

The Infinity weapons are themed, with Blade having +8 Speed, Gavel having 8x crit multiplier, and Dagger having +8 crit chance.
[b]
Update:[/b]

I have buffed 5 early game weapons, obtainable before you get the Galaxy Weapons, to give some variety other than "Lava Katana" which you can farm up if you like. The stats:

[b]Lava Katana (unchanged):[/b] 55-64 damage, +3 Defense, +25 Crit Power, +3 Weight
[b]Dark Sword (obtainable from killing Haunted Skulls):[/b] 66-66 damage, -5 Speed, +3 Crit Chance, +5 Weight, Vampiric
[b][b]Holy Blade (obtainable from smashing crates in the Mines Floors 91-119):[/b] [/b]50-75 damage, +4 Defense, +4 Weight, Crusader[b]
The Slammer (obtainable from smashing crates in the Mines Floors 81-99): [/b]60-75 damage, -2 Speed, +50 Crit Power, +3 Weight
[b]Shadow Dagger (obtainable from smashing crates in the Mines Floors 61-79 and 101-119): [/b]10-20 damage, +4 Crit Chance, +150 Crit Power
[b]Ossified Blade (obtainable from Mystery Boxes or (because of this mod) the Casino):[/b] 50-100 damage, +1 Defense

[b]Update:[/b]

My Unobtainables mod used to add the [b]Ossified Blade [/b]to the [b]Casino[/b]. After patch 1.6, the Ossified Blade is not unobtainable any more. So, I made the Ossified Blade purchasable for [b]10,000 Qi coins[/b] in the Casino as part of this mod here instead, as it fits with the progression of this mod. I found in playthroughs that having the Ossified Blade there made unlocking the Casino feel much more impactful.
